description: Personal hi-tech terminal wallpaper: system info, audio visualizer, graphs, clocks, timers and ASCII art.

newproperty1.text: Note: Changing colors below will affect ASCII art. ASCII art colors are picked by similarity

hidetimepanel.text:
Hide Time Panel
Also hides timers and graphs

newproperty.text:
Timezone: a zone name like Europe/Berlin or America/Los_Angeles (follows daylight saving time), or an hour offset like -7 or 5.5.
Zone list: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

timerstext.text:
Use DD/MM/YYYY for countdowns
or DD/MM for repeated events

graphshelpernote.text: <small>Live CPU / network data needs the metrics helper. Run tools\install-autostart.cmd once to start it with Windows. Without it graphs show mock data.</small>

title: Living-Terminal
